summary: Frontend-only validation of Convertidor de Saldos + Dust Sweep (Resilience Brothers P2P, iter292). Auth via session_token cookies (Turnstile bypass). All 7 scenarios executed on VIP + normal roles. Core conversion flow (USD->CUP @ 395 VIP), MAX button, Dust Sweep single-shot + regeneration, empty-state fallback and no-crash for normal user all work. Two minor observations logged (see minor issues).

issues: Tasa preview line uses 6-decimal fixed formatting: shows '1 USD = 395.000000 CUP'. Not float-noise but excess trailing zeros; consider trimAmount() or maximumFractionDigits based on magnitude for consistency with dashboard (183.967).

ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' surfaces in the CRA red overlay while interacting with Radix Dialog/Select. Benign (well-known Radix issue) but noisy in dev; consider silencing via a global handler.

action_items: (low) Trim trailing zeros in ConvertDialog rate preview (395.000000 -> 395).
(low) Silence ResizeObserver warning in ErrorOverlay (window.addEventListener('error', ...) filter).

(info) VIP seed drift observed: Mongo has USD 525 but /api/vip/balances returned USD 1000 during the run. Likely a previously running smoke test moved funds; not a bug but worth re-seeding balances before future iter runs. Command in test_credentials note is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: AssetsView.jsx: converter is gated behind assets-convert-btn toggle; the task spec referred to 'the dashboard converter card' which is actually on the /activos tab. Testids resolved correctly once navigated.
BalanceConverterCard.jsx: submits with expected_rate (FX10) and op_id (FX09) — confirmed via successful conversion without QUOTE_CHANGED toast.
DustSweepDialog.jsx: correctly regenerates state — after single sweep, CTA disappears and re-opening dialog is impossible from UI (empty state path not needed since CTA hidden).
Two 401 errors on initial load appear in console — likely a pre-auth /api/* call fired before session_token hydration; low priority since app functions.
test_credentials: VIP cookie session_token=smoke_session_vip_iter292 (user_test_vip01), Normal cookie session_token=smoke_session_normal_iter292 (user_test_normal01). Both alive in user_sessions with expires_at 2026-10-22.
seed_data_creation: None created; used pre-seeded VIP + normal users. Note: VIP USD balance drifted from 525 -> 1000 pre-test (previous smoke run). Re-seed if strict equality is needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Converter lives on /activos (nav-assets), toggled by data-testid=assets-convert-btn. Dust sweep threshold is 5 USDT. Conversion fee is 0.01 USDT (paid in USDT, not in source currency). USD->CUP VIP rate=395. Dust sweep + conversion are async; wait ~3-4s after confirm for toast + balance refresh. React dev overlay may intercept clicks during automation; use force=True.
